**Why it needs approval:** per-seat rates can only go to the CFO (Anselm), the deal desk (June) and the account owner. Hollis Mbeki is the Central team lead, so a mail giving him the Quarrendon rate needs June or Anselm to approve it first. That applies to a draft too, even if Dana owns the account.

**What I did:**
- **Recipient:** I checked the company directory. Hollis's address is hmbeki@pemberline.com, so the outside-mail rule doesn't come into it.
- **Approval request:** I logged a request naming June (status: pending) for saving the draft to Hollis with subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate". I asked for it in my reply to Dana rather than messaging June directly. That way the rate Dana gave me privately stays in her own conversation.
- **Reply to Dana:** I said the draft will be saved in her mailbox once June or Anselm approves, so she can send it herself. I didn't repeat the $2,356 figure in the reply. I also offered to draft a version without the rate, covering details like seat counts or renewal dates, since that doesn't need approval.
